title: Thompson
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten rounds of one rope climb starting from seated on the floor, 29 back squats and a 10 m barbell farmers carry with two heavy bars, for time. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Capt. David J. Thompson, commander of ODA 3334, killed in Wardak Province, Afghanistan, in 2010. 290 squats, so the bar is deliberately light.
